Name: Azariah, Son of Johanan
Summary: Azariah, son of Johanan, was one of the heads of Ephraim who stood up against bringing Judah's captives into Samaria and demanded their return.
KeyStory: Azariah the son of Johanan, with three other heads, stood up against them that came from the war and refused the captives.
RelatedPeople: Johanan, Father of Azariah; Johanan, Son of Azariah; Oded, Prophet of Samaria
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
